_: B組 #1 interactive perk (Immersive Interactions style). A perk that adds an '[E] Examine' choice on objects with a keyword and changes the activation prompt. The choice runs a Papyrus fragment (akTargetRef = the activated object, akActor = the activator). Give the perk to the player via script (AddPerk) — there is no record-only way to grant a player perk at game start. Build with `package` so MF_ExaminePerk_Frags.psc compiles and the PerkAdapter VMAD attaches; without the .pex the choice still builds but the fragment won't run. ⚠ The PerkAdapter byte fields + the Activate fragment signature are reflection-shape-verified but pending a main-machine xEdit compare vs a real Immersive Interactions perk (see WAIT_USER). The keyword/spell FormIDs are PLACEHOLDERS — replace via `gamedata find`.

perks.name: Curious Examiner
perks.description: Lets you examine certain objects up close.

effects._: Adds '[E] Examine' on objects that have the (placeholder) keyword. Runs the fragment below.
Changes the default activation label on the same matching objects.
